timeline.a: Hammer at top of swing in frame one, strikes down, the miniature bank shatters, coins fan out, dust kicks up, hammer falls from her grip
Snout dips, trotters rake coins toward her, hammer lies still on the slab
Scoops coins into one loose mound, pats it once, pleased grin, ear twitches
plain. Only her body sways forward, back, side to side; trotters planted, nothing else moves
no pause. Sway leans forward, snout dips over the mound, trotters never lift
One trotter digs into the mound, jingling
Pulls out not a coin but one rusty screw, holds it before her face
She freezes, blank stare at the screw; goat enters large and close, one stride, shoulder-brush passing, teeth lock onto a shard
resumes after the freeze, punchline. Shoulders sag, trotter with the screw stays raised; goat crunches the shard behind her
Goat keeps crunching loudly, deadpan head tilt; she shrugs one shoulder, turns toward the crack
Kneels toward the crack, screw poised at its mouth
Screws it into the crack with small turns of her trotter, dry creak, dust puffing out
One pat on the screw, steps back
Gaze lifts into the lens, doomed-pleased half-smile; goat still chewing over her shoulder
timeline.cam: only camera move in the clip: slow push-in on her face, ending the shot
